title: Beatrix and the Uniform
author: M. M. Vasquez
blurb: Felix Whitlock, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
